description.intro: The Puma Buzz medium sports bag combines a sleek, minimalist design with the functionality you need for training, short trips or daily commutes. Its black finish and embossed Puma logo provide a modern and versatile aesthetic that fits into any situation. Thanks to its comfortable carrying handles and lightweight structure, it is an ideal companion for those looking for practicality without giving up style.

Comfortable transport: Sturdy handles for easy and safe handling.
